title: [BUG] Provide a way to disable the annoying new Tip Banner
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [ ] Anthropic API - [ ] AWS Bedrock - [ ] Google Vertex AI - [ ] Other: - Claude CLI version: latest - Operating System: Ubunutu 22.04 - Terminal: Bash ## Bug Description Provide a way to disable the annoying new Tip Banner. No one asked you to invent banner ads for console. Stop trying to ruin a perfect product through frequent and annoying new features that no one asked for. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Start doing your work like a good little paying customer 2. Engineers at Anthropic get a brilliant idea to add annoying tip banner in their unusually frequent releases. 4. ## Expected Behavior To not have distracting text in my coding tool. Trust me no serious dev wants or needs it. ## Actual Behavior Annoying Tip banner that is updating with new tips no one asked for. ## Additional Context Let me work on peace. Stop meddling.
author: cutoken

top_comments.author: moltar
top_comments.body:
Yes, please so annoying, delete it.

Why isn't there a setting for this? Who thought it was a great idea to ship an annoying feature without a kill switch?

top_comments.author: winrid
top_comments.body: This is very distracting because it always looks like there's an action item.
